// @path: src/lib/ops/schools.ts
// @expect: OPS-BANNED-IDENTIFIER
import "server-only";

// `requestReason` is denied by name as well as by its model's class: it is an
// adult's free text about why a class's records were asked for, and the same
// R15 reasoning that denies `handoverReason` applies. Naming it under the ops
// roots at all is the thing this refuses.
export function summarise(rows: Array<{ requestReason: string }>) {
  return rows.map((r) => r.requestReason).join("; ");
}
